stories.head: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon for complex workflows
stories.fact: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available through its API for paying developers and enterprises, with rollout to AI Ultra subscribers. It targets complex coding, knowledge work and scientific reasoning with extended verification loops.
stories.why: Test multi-step MATLAB debugging on a frozen task set, recording correctness, verification coverage, latency and cost.
stories.unc: Capability and economic claims are vendor-reported; longer reasoning does not guarantee correct code or research.
stories.alt: Conceptual labels connect complex tasks with verification loops, identify API and Ultra access, and require correctness, time and cost testing.

stories.head: Preprint challenges identification of market-impact decay
stories.fact: Fujiwara, Sato and Kanazawa show that, under their diffusive-price and long-memory order-flow assumptions, propagator estimation can infer transient impact even when true impact is permanent. Their null model demonstrates this identification failure.
stories.why: Stress execution simulators against permanent-impact nulls before teaching a policy that waiting automatically restores liquidity.
stories.unc: The result concerns a specified estimation framework, not proof that real-world impact never decays; this is a preprint.
labels: Null model: true impact is permanent
stories.alt: Conceptual labels distinguish estimated decay from true permanent impact under the paper’s assumptions; no calibrated decay curve is shown.

stories.head: Nasdaq futures lead the premarket rebound
stories.fact: At 5:04 a.m. EST, Reuters reported Nasdaq 100 futures up 1.67%, S&P 500 futures up 0.74%, and Dow futures up 0.03%.
stories.why: Monitor QQQ versus SPY and distinguish a concentrated technology bounce from broad participation.
stories.unc: Earlier reported snapshot, not live executable quotes; price gains do not establish healthy depth.
stories.alt: Three labels compare Nasdaq, S&P and Dow futures percentage gains at the same November 11 checkpoint.

stories.head: October CPI rises 0.4%; annual comparisons are incomplete
stories.fact: BLS reported October CPI up 0.4% month over month, seasonally adjusted, and core CPI up 0.3%. Missing October 2025 survey data prevent publication of many official October 2026 twelve-month changes.
stories.why: Use official monthly readings and data-availability flags; do not silently replace missing annual inflation with an estimate.
stories.unc: Missing year-ago observations limit comparisons. CPI is not the Fed’s preferred PCE inflation measure.
stories.alt: Separate labels show October monthly headline and core CPI changes, with an explicit missing annual-comparison warning.

stories.head: CoreWeave revenue expands while financing costs weigh
stories.fact: CoreWeave reported Q3 revenue of $3.661 billion, GAAP operating income of $207 million and net loss of $709 million. Net interest expense was $846 million.
stories.why: Evaluate demand growth alongside financing burden and cash requirements; operating income alone does not establish bottom-line profitability.
stories.unc: Adjusted metrics differ from GAAP; backlog and forward guidance depend on future delivery and are not cash in hand.
stories.alt: Four distinct labels show CoreWeave revenue, GAAP operating income, net loss and net interest expense; the measures are not added together.
